name: dumi
description: dumi is a React-based static site generator for component libraries and documentation, built on Umi, that turns Markdown into static HTML pages.
notes: firstRelease from npm dumi creation (2019-12-27). This setup pins dumi 2.4.50 and overrides the default theme layout (.dumi/theme/layouts/DocLayout) with a bare one: no navbar, sidebar, TOC, search or footer; it renders only the post, and the index page lists all posts.
